osaka_kitashinchi_shime.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. Sashimi, fried oysters, menchi katsu, soba and clam ramen to finish; nothing is described as gluten-free.
osaka_kitashinchi_shime.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya; the soba and ramen are served in dashi or clam broth.
osaka_kitashinchi_shime.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 17:00–1:00; Sat 17:00–23:00, reservation only; closed Sundays and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private rooms in principle for four or more (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), IC cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 20 seats: 6 at the counter, 8 at tables, a private room of 6; heated tobacco in a designated area, cigarettes outside; e-cigarettes allowed in private rooms (Tabelog; March 2026). Opened 1 July 2023 (Tabelog).
osaka_kitashinchi_shime.notes: [Izakaya · Kitashinchi, seafood and a noodle to finish] A calm fifth-floor izakaya in the Kitashinchi Building, a few steps from an underground-mall exit, named for the shime, the noodle that ends a night: soba or a rich clam ramen. Before that come generous sashimi platters served one per person (Nagasaki sea snail, Kagoshima tuna and amberjack, a seared Kagawa scallop), big Goto Islands oysters, firefly squid, homemade tofu and dashimaki, at prices diners call fair for Kitashinchi (2025–26). There is also a kue hotpot course with fish from the Goto Islands. Private rooms suit business dinners, and e-cigarettes are allowed there. Open until 1:00 on weekdays; Saturday by booking only.

chef_bio.background: Per the shop-maintained Tabelog listing: seasonal seafood and selected sake, finishing with soba or ramen, "the chef's special dishes"; courses include Nagasaki kue hotpot with fish from the Goto Islands "delivered directly from our sister restaurant in Fukuoka"; opened 1 July 2023. A July 2026 diner mentions the shop's duck mascot.
chef_bio.specialty: Sashimi platter; clam ramen or soba to finish.

anecdotes.text: "The assorted sashimi platter (JPY 1,800, tax included) was served individually, making it easy to eat, which was a thoughtful touch." — July 2026.
"Although Kitashinchi has a reputation for being upscale, I was pleasantly surprised by how affordable this place was." — December 2025.
"The soba served at the end was also very tasty, further enhancing my satisfaction with the meal." — March 2026.
